name: Tuya BLE
description: Tuya / Smart Life BLE fingerprint (bound/unbound, connectivity, ...) and simple simulator.
author: BLESPloit
notes: Observer parses 0x07D0 manufacturer data + 0xA201 service data (bound bit, protocol version, UUID vs product key). Unbound ads are pairing mode: grey icon when bound, Tuya-red when unbound. Product name/icon come from the Tuya cloud, not the advertisement - unbound hint points at the Tuya app (check the device model/details, bind to your account). GATT identity confirms 0xFD50 vs legacy 0x1910 after connect; plaintext 0x0000 device-info is ignored on real modules (needs a cloud auth-key session). Pairing and DP control are out of scope. Peripheral sim is an unbound TY (legacy ADV_IND: flags+0xA201 UUID+service data; scan response: name TY + 0x07D0 MSD) that answers unencrypted 0x0000.
